description: Per-bank historical benchmarking: 1Y/3Y/5Y/10Y/15Y change for each metric, plus the all-time high and low in this dataset and the year each occurred. change_pct is percent change; change_abs is the raw difference, which is the meaningful one for metrics that are already percentages (npl_pct, car_pct, roe). percentile_of_own_history places the latest reading inside that bank's own range - 100 means an all-time high.
horizons_note: A horizon is null where that bank has no observation that many years back. MIDLANDBNK and NRBCBANK only exist from FY2013, so their 15Y windows are empty by construction, not by data loss.
